source_note: source_sha256 is the SHA-256 of content/batches/023-proposed.json, the bytes npm run batch:adopt 023 moves over the original. original_sha256 is the author's file as reviewed (6fdf276a…).
review_type: Independent AI editorial review of nine original A2 listening fragments (DUO Luisteren A2) before audio: keys proven from verbatim evidence, every distractor tested against the fragment, level heuristics and exam likeness judged per item, voice pairing and image briefs checked against config/voices.json and config/illustration.json; required and recommended edits applied by the reviewer in the proposed file (docs/briefs/review.md), text rebuilt mechanically from the scripts.

edits.new_text: Twelve turns reduced to ten: the "Duurt het gesprek lang? / Ongeveer tien minuten." exchange dropped; "Wilt u liever naar de praktijk komen? Dan kan dat pas volgende week woensdag." moved into the assistant's turn 7; her turn 9 ends "Houd donderdag wel uw telefoon bij de hand."; De Vries closes "Dat doe ik. Dank u wel."
edits.why: Blueprint 4.2: conversations have four to ten turns; the tested facts are now said once. Evidence quotes of q1–q3 unchanged; 161 → 147 spoken words.

edits.new_text: De workshop duurt twee ochtenden, volgende week dinsdag en donderdag, van negen tot twaalf uur.
edits.why: The q3 key "uiterlijk vrijdag" must precede the workshop; in the original the deadline came after the two workshop days of the same week (rubric 4).

edits.new_text: B: "Haar cv op papier meenemen." Explanation: "Wie nog geen cv heeft, maakt het in de workshop. Thuis een cv maken hoeft dus niet, en een cv op papier meenemen geldt alleen voor wie al een cv heeft. De afspraak met de adviseur komt pas na de workshop."
edits.why: The laptop was the distractor of q1 and q2 in the same item; the new distractor is the other branch of the condition in the same passage.

edits.new_text: Thirteen turns reduced to ten: "De grote graag, van chocolade. En kan er een tekst op?"; "Hartelijk gefeliciteerd, papa. Kan ik de taart zaterdag ophalen? Het liefst zo vroeg mogelijk."; the seller closes "…als u de taart ophaalt. Tot zaterdag."
edits.why: Blueprint 4.2 turn count; q1 and q3 evidence unchanged; 136 → 130 spoken words.

edits.new_text: Prompt "Roos wil de taart zaterdag ophalen. Hoe laat is de taart klaar?"; A "Om acht uur." B "Om elf uur." C "Om twaalf uur."; answer B; evidence "Maar de taart is pas om elf uur klaar."; explanation "De taart is zaterdag pas om elf uur klaar, dus Roos komt na elf uur. Om acht uur gaat de winkel pas open, en twaalf is het aantal personen, geen tijd."
edits.why: The old distractor "Zaterdag om twaalf uur." satisfied the old key "Zaterdag na elf uur." (twelve is after eleven), so it was not clearly false (rubric 5 and 7).

edits.new_text: A "Tussen twaalf en vier uur." B "'s Avonds na negen uur." C "'s Ochtends vroeg."; answer C; explanation "Zwaar werk doet u liever 's ochtends vroeg. Tussen twaalf en vier uur blijft u juist binnen of in de schaduw, en negen uur 's avonds is de sluitingstijd van het zwembad, geen advies over werk."
edits.why: "Op zaterdag." was defensible because the fragment says "Zaterdag wordt het koeler" (rubric 7); three parallel time-of-day options remain. Key D → C.

edits.new_text: Twelve turns reduced to ten ("Voor hoe lang is dit doosje?" folded into the assistant's second turn as "Dit doosje is voor drie maanden."); "Ik heb gebeld voor een herhaalrecept." (was "gisteren gebeld"); "Doe dat op tijd, dus als u nog tabletten voor een week hebt." (was "op tijd: als …"); q2 evidence "U belt ons, of u bestelt op onze website. Doe dat op tijd, dus als u nog tabletten voor een week hebt."
edits.why: "Gisteren gebeld" contradicted "Twee werkdagen later ligt het klaar" (rubric 9); the ordering rule's meaning depended on a colon (blueprint 4.2); blueprint 4.2 turn count and the author's own contingency cut, 179 → 166 spoken words. q1 and q3 evidence unchanged.

decisions_on_author_doubts.1_spoor_vs_batch002_trein: Accepted: delay, terminating train, transfer rule and a second train make it the fuller replacement the research document asks for; retire batch002-trein at the rebuild and never place the two in one set.
decisions_on_author_doubts.2_donderdagmiddag: Kept: "tussen twee en drie uur" right after "Vanmiddag lukt niet" is the afternoon; the small paraphrase is what the rubric asks for and the explanation spells it out.
decisions_on_author_doubts.3_studiedag_voice: Kept f-adult: a named person addresses a room; the narrator voice also reads every question, so a different voice separates fragment from question.
decisions_on_author_doubts.4_ggd: Kept: a real body named generically (blueprint 8); the media stage listens to how the voice reads "GGD".
decisions_on_author_doubts.5_pharmacy_neighbours: Accepted: not in one session with batch005-tabletten; the reading letter and the B1 item are other parts or levels. Assistant stays f-young (f-adult already carries two fragments; genders differ within the dialogue).
decisions_on_author_doubts.6_verjaardagstaart_twaalf: Justified for a different reason: twelve o'clock is after eleven, so the distractor satisfied the key; fixed by asking the time the cake is ready.
decisions_on_author_doubts.7_item9_length: The contingency cut is applied now; the longest fragment is 166 spoken words.

(two to three o'clock, said right after 'Vanmiddag lukt niet', is the afternoon); A refuted by 'Vanmiddag lukt niet, want dan heeft ze spreekuur', C is the visit date 'Dan kan dat pas volgende week woensdag'. q2 D proven by 'De dokter wil de uitslag zelf met u bespreken. diversity_review: Nine settings, six task types (gesprek 3, omroep 2, uitleg, reclame, voicemail, nieuws), seven domains (gezondheid 3, winkels-diensten 2, opleiding, vervoer, werk, vrije-tijd-familie; no wonen-buurt, no instanties). No re-skin of an existing item; no six-word phrase overlap. Near pairs accepted with placement rules: spoor / batch002-trein (retire the latter) and batch022-loket (transfer rule); turnles / batch005-voetbal (trainer voicemail) and batch022-kinderopvang (voicemail to a parent); verjaardagstaart / batch002-bakker (cake); herhaalmedicijn / batch005-tabletten (pharmacy counter); cv-workshop / batch005-computercursus (untested background facts: laptops provided, group of ten).
set_assembly: Drills of four fragments by task type as in a2-listening-03..05: conversations bloedonderzoek, verjaardagstaart, herhaalmedicijn plus batch022-garage or batch022-pakket; announcements and voicemails studiedag, spoor, turnles plus batch022-sluitingstijd; monologues cv-workshop, bezorgservice, hitte plus batch022-koffiegeld or batch022-taalcafe. Never spoor with batch002-trein or batch022-loket, turnles with batch005-voetbal, herhaalmedicijn with batch005-tabletten, verjaardagstaart with batch002-bakker; in a mock form keep the two gezondheid conversations non-adjacent.
media_notes: Voices: f-adult + m-older (bloedonderzoek), f-young + m-shop (verjaardagstaart), m-young + f-young (herhaalmedicijn), f-adult (studiedag, a person in a room), narrator (spoor, also the question voice), m-adult (cv-workshop, matches the still), presenter (bezorgservice, hitte), m-young (turnles). Round-trip listening points: "cv" six times in cv-workshop (must be spelled out; switch script and questions to "CV" in a focused revision if a voice reads it as a word), "GGD" in hitte and its q1 prompt, "Hartelijk gefeliciteerd, papa." as quoted cake text. Stills: five briefs with cast traits verbatim, no tested detail shown; check that the "blank sheet of paper" in cv-workshop stays blank and the van in bezorgservice carries no logo; the herhaalmedicijn still will resemble batch005-tabletten (acceptable). No still for the announcements, the voicemail and the radio news, as in batches 005 and 022.
coordinator_notes: Adopt with npm run batch:adopt 023; the review hash is that of the proposed file.
Retire or rewrite batch002-trein when the A2 listening bank is rebuilt; spoor is its fuller replacement.
After audio generation, listen to cv-workshop for "cv" and hitte for "GGD" even if the round trip passes.
The author's notes (023-notes.md) describe the original turn counts, word counts and the old q2 of verjaardagstaart; they read as history and need no edit.
limitations: This is an AI editorial review of scripts before audio exists. It does not replace review by a Dutch-language educator, learner trials or psychometric calibration, and it does not establish equivalence with the official DUO exam; every A2 label stays an unvalidated authoring target.
content/exemplars/ does not exist; the level column compares each fragment with the blueprint description of the official fragment types and with the integrated batch 005 and sibling batch 022 items.
Originality was judged by plausibility and by the phrase scan against this project's own content, not against official practice audio; the name checks were single web searches on 2026-09-10.

The verdicts apply to the proposed bytes at the recorded source_sha256; the listening items remain blocked for publication until the generated audio passes the round-trip check and the stills pass the media review.
